CustomField.description: This field is required for "Closed: Forward" and the "Forward to Unit" = ServiceNow. This field holds the ServiceNow ticket number for case it's attached to.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field is the ServiceNow ticket number related to this case and contact. This field is required if case status is Closed:Forward and Forward to Unit = ServiceNow.
